name: NetBird for GNOME
description:
Control the local NetBird daemon from GNOME Quick Settings and a native GTK interface. Requires NetBird 0.76.0 or later with its HTTP/JSON Unix socket enabled.

Clipboard access: the extension writes your NetBird IP address, name, or a peer's address to the clipboard only when you click an address in the NetBird window or choose a Copy action. It never reads the clipboard.
